about: The starter chest: handed out once per world, to the first player on a planet, in the same grant as the two starting Ovens (mars.planets.GrantEvents). Conductor ores are rare, so machines are not blocked while the player looks for them (SME docs/science/mars-conductor-and-carbonate-ores.md section 3). The amounts (4 copper ingots, 8 redstone dust) are the SME's and Game Designer's suggestion and are INVENTED game balance. Labelled 'from the lander' in the chest name.
